title: Web Development
description:
I have worked as a freelancer developing websites and software for both clients and my own projects. I have created commercial websites for brands and products, data management systems, 3D editing tools and small programs designed to optimize specific tasks within my workflow.

I combine creative and technical approach to design coherent, functional and visually professional solutions, always adapted to the style and needs of the project. I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python, using various libraries to create both web applications and local programs.
